ops.en: THE DESCENT. va-yered yehuda me-et echav — the seller of gen_60 goes DOWN from his brothers while Joseph goes down to Egypt: the letter runs the two descents in parallel. adulami with the lamed dagesheed [VERIFIED: manifest G61-11].
THE TAKING. va-yar sham yehuda bat ish kenaani u-shemo shua — the wife enters nameless, a daughter of her father's name only; the ledger will record her death the same way (38:12).
THE FIRSTBORN BORN. va-tahar va-teled ben.

HE NAMED [G61-01]. va-YIQRA et shemo er — the Masorah's rule: every conceived-and-bore takes SHE-named except THREE he-named (Er here, Gershom, Beriah) [VERIFIED: manifest G61-01; the stream splits exactly — the father names the firstborn, the mother names the next two]. Ramban: Judah himself named him. REGISTRY write 1.
THE SECOND SON. va-tahar od va-teled ben.
SHE NAMED. va-TIQRA et shemo onan — the rule's ordinary voice returns [G61-01, asserted]. REGISTRY write 2.
THE THIRD SON. va-tosef od va-teled ben.

SHE NAMED AGAIN. va-tiqra et shemo shela — ve-haya vi-KHEZIV be- lidtah oto: the birthplace's skeleton is the lie-word (kazav), the reading tradition's note on the son who will be withheld on a false promise; letter-note. REGISTRY write 3.

THE ONE FULL FIRSTBORN [G61-02]. le-er BEKHORO — 'his firstborn' written FULL with vav, ONCE in the Torah, here on the son about to die [VERIFIED: manifest G61-02; the lean pair, Sidon and Uz, asserted]; u-shemah TAMAR — she enters by name, unlike the wife of 38:2.
THE FIRST DEATH. va-yehi er... ra be-ene YHWH va-yemitehu YHWH — the verdict and the execution in one verse; the letter never names the deed (the reading tradition supplies it from Onan's, named).

THE SEED-DEMAND. bo el eshet achikha ve-yabem otah ve-haqem ZERA le- achikha — three imperatives folded to one demand: raise seed for your brother. Pushed on ONAN — and the span will discharge it through JUDAH HIMSELF (38:27, the twins): the demandee-mismatch class (gen_46's Isaac-blessing precedent), the unit's machine heart.

THE LEVIRATE INSTITUTION'S BIRTH-SEAT [claim G61-14]. Judah is read as the FIRST to perform the levirate obligation, generations before it is commanded at Deuteronomy 25:5. The reading carries with it a formal rule of legal state, quoted whole: what was permitted, then prohibited, then permitted again returns NOT to its first permission but to a SECOND — so "her husband's brother shall consort wit…

THE SUBVERSION. ve-shichet artza le-vilti netan-zera le-achiv — Onan performs the coming and refuses the demand's substance: the machine keeps the seed-demand OPEN through his act (obedience in form, refusal in fact). netan with the tav soft, qamatz alone, per MS (asserted); lo LO with the soft-lamed ruling of the precise books (named).
THE SECOND DEATH. va-yamet GAM oto — the also-word with its hardening dot [VERIFIED: manifest G61-12 set, asserted]: the letter counts the deaths.

THE SIT-DEMAND. shevi almana vet-avikh ad yigdal shela veni — pushed with a stated condition; the narrator immediately discloses the true clause (ki amar pen yamut gam hu). Tamar obeys within the verse.

OBEYED AT ONCE. va-telekh tamar va-teshev bet aviha — pushed and satisfied in the SAME verse: the only instantly-obeyed demand in the span; its condition (Shelah grown, Tamar given) is the one the letter will convict at 38:14 and 38:26. bet-avikh's bet soft per MS (asserted).

THE PIVOT. va-tamat bat-shua... va-yinachem yehuda — Judah's comfort ACCEPTED against his father's comfort REFUSED (37:35): the letter sets the two mourners one chapter apart. va-yaal al gozaze tzono — the shearing road, where the house of Jacob transacts (31:19, and 38's own road ahead).
THE TELLING. va-yugad le-tamar lemor — the agentless report (the span's telling-verbs run passive: 38:13, 38:24); she acts on news, as Judah will.

THE INDICTMENT CLAUSE [G61-09]. ki raata KI GADAL shela ve-hiv lo nitna lo le-isha — the narrator convicts the condition of 38:11: Shelah IS grown, Tamar is NOT given. And ki gadal stands exactly TWICE in the Torah — here and Isaac's greatness (26:13) [VERIFIED: manifest G61-09]: the Kitzur reads the pair toward the kingdom that grows from her. The garments do the speaking: widow's off, veil on (a…
THE MISREADING. va-yachsheveha le-zona ki khista paneha — the Kitzur's harlot-pair (Isaiah's city, outside the instrument) files named: Tamar in disgrace and honored at the end, as the city.

THE REQUEST. hava-na avo elayikh — pushed; the narrator's disclosure rides it (ki lo yada ki khalato hiv). Her answer is a price- question: ma titen li — and SNAPSHOT writes the crowding dagesh in LI where MS rules the lamed soft: a pointing DISCREPANCY, filed [manifest G61-12].

THE GOAT AGAIN. anokhi ashalach GEDI IZIM min ha-tzon — a kid of the goats: the same animal-class whose blood played Joseph's death one chapter ago (37:31) now offered as a harlot's fee; the letter prices the deceptions in the same coin. Her word: ERAVON ('pledge') — the security-noun's Torah career lives in this chapter (38:17, 18, 20).

THE KID FOR THE KID [claim G61-13, machine-checked — NEW AT DERIVATION]. The kid-of-goats stands in Genesis at exactly four places, in two matched pairs: 27:9 and 27:16, where Jacob is dressed in kid-skins to deceive his blind father, and here and 38:20, where Judah's pledged kid is what Tamar turns against him. The deception worked with a kid is undone by a kid one generation on. The same word ca…
GIVEN, COME, CONCEIVED. va-yiten lah va-yavo eleha va-tahar LO — the request discharges and the conception is credited to him by the letter's own dative.

THE STAFF OF THE WONDERS [G61-06]. chotamkha u-fetilekha u-matekha — and the staff-word u-matkha stands exactly TWICE in the Torah: Judah's pledge and 'your staff with which you struck the Nile' (Exod 17:5) [VERIFIED: manifest G61-06]: the Kitzur — the staff left in her hand is the staff of the miracles. The Kitzur's cord-reading (the cords = the tefillin) files named.

THE PLEDGE IS THE DYNASTY'S THREE CROWNS [claim G61-15]. The collateral Judah hands over is decoded as the house's three offices — the signet as KINGSHIP, the cord as the SANHEDRIN (marked by its sky-blue thread), and the staff as the MESSIANIC KING. Witness-tier state: ordinary security in the grammar, dynastic instruments in the reading, and the machine holds the second sense at witness tier onl…

THE CODE CLOSES. va-tasar tzeifah me-aleha va-tilbash bigde almenutah — the veil off, the widowhood back on: her disguise lasted one transaction; Judah's misreading is the only thing that stays dressed.

NOT FOUND [G61-10]. ve-lo METZAAH — the found-her skeleton has exactly FOUR Torah stations: the dove that found no rest (8:9), this road (38:20), the redeemer's sufficiency (Lev 25:28), and 'in the field he found her' (Deut 22:27) [VERIFIED: manifest G61-10]: the Kitzur pairs the road and the field — found once at the road, never again.

THE WORD-SHIFT. aye ha-QEDESHA — the friend softens Judah's zona (38:15) to the cult-word before strangers; the townsmen answer with the same word doubled (38:21, 38:22): lo hayta va-ze qedesha. Letter-note: the span's politest lie.
THE REPORT. lo metzatiha — the errand returns empty; the pledge stays in her hand for the day it must speak.

THE SCORN-WORD [G61-12]. TIQACH lah pen nihye LA-VUZ — tiqach with the qof dagesheed, and where MS records the books DIVIDED on the meteg (tav-camp vs qof-camp) SNAPSHOT writes BOTH strokes: a both- camps station [VERIFIED: manifest G61-12]. The Kitzur's scorn-pair: because he crooked his father's heart with haker-na, he became the scorn of haker-na (named — the pair lands at 38:25).

THE ORDER THAT DIES [G61-07]. hotziuha ve-tisaref — pushed, and NEVER executed: the recognition reverses it and the span ends with the burn-order still open on the queue — the second dead demand in two units (gen_60's kill-demand). And the verdict carries the Name in its initials: yehuda-hotziuha-ve-tisaref + the next verse's opening hi = the four letters [VERIFIED: manifest G61-07]: the Kitzur — …

THE PAIR LANDS [G60-12 -> G61]. haker-na le-mi ha-chotemet — the EXACT phrase of the coat (37:32) returned to its sender: Sotah 10b's measure-for-measure, the two-unit crown closed. And the four words' FINAL letters, read from the last word back, spell tira — FEAR: she said, fear the One and confess [VERIFIED: manifest G61-08]. lo anokhi with the lamed dagesheed [G61-11, asserted].

THE FURNACE-VERSE'S LETTERS [G61-03/04/05]. hiv MUTZET — written he- vav, read she [VERIFIED: manifest G61-03]: R. Huna — SHE and HE were due to come out; the written form keeps the man inside her sentence. The furnace-teaching (better the furnace than a fellow's public shame — Ketubot 67b, Sotah 10b, Bava Metzia 59a) hangs on this word, and R. Chananel read it LEAN of its aleph ('set alight') — t…

RECOGNIZED AND CONFESSED. va-yaker yehuda — the demand discharges in one verb, and the confession follows: tzadqa mimeni, 'she is more righteous than I' — the only self-verdict in the span, spoken by the man who ordered the burning; the order itself is never executed and never revoked on the letter: it dies open. ve-lo yasaf od le-data — with the stress falling end-ward against the Michlol's custo…

THE VOICE AS THE COURT'S MISSING WITNESS [claim G61-16]. At "she is more righteous than I" the reading hears a Divine Voice supplying the testimony no human witness could give — "you attest what is revealed; I attest what is concealed" — and counts three courts where the Voice so testified. The received translation splits the same word two ways, rendering a verdict about her plus a separate admiss…

THE DEMAND COMES HOME. ve-hine TEOMIM be-vitnah — the seed-demand Judah pushed on Onan (38:8) discharges through JUDAH HIMSELF: the demandee-mismatch class (gen_46's precedent) at full span — pushed on the brother, refused, and satisfied by the father of the command. teomim here written FULL against the lean תומם of Rebecca's twins (25:24, gen_43's crown) — the two twin-verses split their spelling…

THE MARKED HAND. va-yiten yad... va-tiqshor al yado SHANI — the scarlet thread marks a firstbornhood that withdraws: the span's last identity-object (seal, cord, staff, thread — the chapter argues by tokens).

THE FOUR HANDS AT THE BIRTH [claim G61-17]. The hand-word is counted four times across the birth scene and the count is read forward — either to the four bans that Peretz's line would breach, or to the four items Akhan took from the ban at Jericho. A numeric reading of this scene's own repetitions, recorded at witness tier and owed to the test that would check it.
THE BREACH. ve-hine yatza achiv — the unmarked one comes first.

NAMED FOR THE BREACH. ma paratzta alekha paretz va-yiqra shemo paretz — the Kitzur: the king breaches fences and none may protest; the atbash-and-sum readings toward David file named. REGISTRY write 4.
THE MARKED ONE SECOND. ve-achar yatza achiv asher al yado ha-shani.

NAMED FOR THE SHINING. va-yiqra shemo zarach — five names in the span, five REGISTRY writes: Er, Onan, Shelah by the parents' split voices; Peretz and Zerach by the birth itself. The span closes with the burn-order still open — the machine's record that the sentence was never carried out, only outgrown.
